name: migration
description: Evidence-led UK migration & demographics explorer (Phase 5 HTML)

scripts.build: node scripts/write-manifest.mjs && node scripts/normalize-geo.mjs && node scripts/ingest.mjs && node scripts/check-catalog.mjs
scripts.refresh: bash scripts/download-raw.sh && node scripts/write-manifest.mjs && node scripts/normalize-geo.mjs && node scripts/ingest.mjs && node scripts/check-catalog.mjs && node scripts/write-refresh-status.mjs --ok
scripts.refresh:force: bash scripts/download-raw.sh --force && node scripts/write-manifest.mjs && node scripts/normalize-geo.mjs && node scripts/ingest.mjs && node scripts/check-catalog.mjs && node scripts/write-refresh-status.mjs --ok
